header.name: Orders Web Flow
header.description: - This data flow is responsible for creating, updating, and deleting orders and order lines. The functionality was moved from the screen transform to the flow to provide greater control, simplify maintenance, and make future enhancements easier to implement.

data.mutation:
mutation CreateOrder($payload: [OrderCreatePayloadInput!]!) {
  createOrder(payload: $payload) {
    id
    number
    active
    extStatus
    externalId
    customData
    integrationData
    orderStatusId
    orderTypeId
    businessPartnerId
    businessPartnerAddressId
    destinationBusinessPartnerId
    destinationBusinessPartnerAddressId
    loadId
    specialInstructions
  }
}
